dependencies.python: No new dependencies. math.isclose for tolerances.

story-context.constraints: - File: src/depeg_sim/protocol/amm.py only (plus tests). No changes to kernel/ except config.py task 1. - Floats in token units; no Decimal; no integer wei scaling. - Fee on input; fee remains in reserves; k non-decreasing. - Rejections are ExecutionResult(ok=False) + swap_rejected event, never exceptions. Only fee_bps range at construction raises. - quote() must not mutate state; swap() must mutate exactly reserves and cumulative_fees. - No liquidity add/remove. No multi-pool. No routing. - peg_deviation = spot_price / peg_price - 1.0; negative under stable selling. - name="amm" fixed; phases == frozenset({Phase.EXECUTION}). - Python 3.12-compatible.

interfaces.interface: __init__(reserve_stable: float, reserve_reference: float, fee_bps: int, peg_price: float = 1.0, name: str = "amm") quote(amount_in: float, side: str) -> Quote swap(amount_in: float, side: str) -> SwapResult spot_price: float (property); peg_deviation: float (property); k: float (property); cumulative_fees: float execute(ctx, action) -> ExecutionResult ; on_phase(ctx, phase) -> None ; snapshot() -> dict classmethod from_config(cfg: AMMConfig, peg_price: float) -> ConstantProductAMM
side, amount_in, amount_out, execution_price, spot_before, spot_after, slippage, fee_paid
Internal; raised by _compute on invalid input and caught by execute() to produce swap_rejected. quote()/swap() called directly may raise it.

tests.standards: tests/test_amm.py for unit; tests/test_amm_integration.py for engine runs. Numeric assertions via math.isclose with explicit tolerances. Property test draws from numpy.random.default_rng(12345) directly (unit test, no ctx) or from a RunContext rng (integration).
